proposals.before: When Jing was pacified, Emperor Wen became administrator of Wu Commandery and made Zhongju deputy administrator; together with Yu Chi of Yingchuan he were both Emperor Wen's clients.

proposals.reason: Chinese 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tiancheng; year conversion (560) is otherwise correct.

proposals.before: Jiao early took part in intimate service, [8] once shared in hardship and peril, knew that he had no concealment, and was rewarded with full exertion; there was the sincerity of one trusted, not ground for suspicion.
proposals.after: Jiao early took part in intimate service, [8] once shared in hardship and peril; [the emperor] knew that he had nothing to hide and rewarded him for exerting his full strength—there was the sincerity of one trusted, not ground for suspicion.

decisions.reason: s0016 opens with 天嘉元年; the Chen reign name is Tianjia, not Tiancheng, and the proposed sentence otherwise matches the offices, fief, and AD 560 conversion.
The same unit’s literal field also renders 天嘉 as Tiancheng; replacing it with Tianjia corrects the reign name while leaving the rest of the literal wording intact.
s0028 信義長公主 is the Senior Princess of Xinyi; "Princess Xin’an the Long of Xinyi" misreads 長公主 and invents Xin’an, while the proposed title matches the Chinese.
s0058 twice names 文帝 as the campaigner and holder of the prefectural city; "the Founder" (高祖) is the wrong person, and Emperor Wen restores the source referent.
The literal of s0058 likewise substitutes Founder for 文帝; replacing both occurrences with Emperor Wen matches the Chinese agents.

decisions.after: [1] Zhang Biao returned by night from Shan county to storm the city. Emperor Wen slipped out the north gate. In the sudden dark the troops panicked. decisions.reason: s0061 repeatedly has 文帝, so Founder is wrong; the proposed Emperor Wen swaps are right, but "to Wenyü, bring back" remains ungrammatical, so the infinitive needs "to bring back".
s0061’s literal likewise calls 文帝 the Founder three times; Emperor Wen correctly restores the named actor in each slot.

The literal of s0062 makes the same Founder error for 文帝; Emperor Wen is the correct owner of the scattered troops.
